news.title: Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now
news.summary: Pre-loading is open for everyone who pre-ordered digitally. Code-in-box buyers can activate their code and pre-load as soon as it arrives.

news.title: Explore the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Gallery
news.summary: Two weeks before launch, Rockstar published a new collection of screenshots of Vice City and beyond on the official site.

news.title: Announcing Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, Coming November 19
news.summary: The official soundtrack album, made with Atlantic Records, launches alongside the game on November 19 and can be pre-saved on major streaming services.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look — Now Playing
news.summary: An extended look captured entirely from in-game footage on PlayStation 5.

news.title: Watch the Grand Theft Auto VI Launch Trailer
news.summary: When an easy score goes wrong, Jason and Lucia end up on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI Pre-Load Begins on November 10
news.summary: Pre-loading on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S starts November 10, ahead of the November 19 launch.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI is Now Set to Launch November 19, 2026
news.summary: Rockstar sets the release for November 19, 2026, saying the extra time will help finish the game to its intended level of polish.

news.title: Grand Theft Auto VI — Watch Trailer 2 Now
news.summary: Trailer 2 introduces Jason and Lucia's story: a failed score pulls them into a criminal conspiracy across Leonida.
